content.description: Illustration showing a screwdriver prying up locking lugs on a connector terminal to remove it from the rear

content.text: (b) Pry up the locking lugs with the screwdriver and pull the terminal out from the rear.

content.description: Illustration showing a terminal being pushed into a connector with an arrow indicating direction

items: (a) Push in the terminal until it is securely locked in the connector lug.
(b) Pull on the wire to confirm that it is securely locked.

content.description: Illustration showing hands removing a circuit breaker from a kick panel
Illustration showing an ohmmeter being used to check continuity on a circuit breaker with a needle in reset hole

items: (a) Insert the needle into the reset hole and push it.
(b) Using an ohmmeter, check that there is continuity between both terminals of the circuit breaker.

content.text: If there is no continuity, replace the circuit breaker.

content.description: Illustration showing hands installing a circuit breaker into kick panel with arrow indicating direction

content.text: NOTE: If a circuit breaker continues to cut out, a short circuit is indicated. Have the system checked by a qualified technician.
